title: Triple-dimer web formulas for twists of the four specified cubic Gr three eight and Gr three nine expressions
author: Elkin, Moriah; Musiker, Gregg; Wright, Kayla
work: Twists of $\mathrm{Gr}(3,n)$ Cluster Variables as Double and Triple Dimer Partition Functions
difficulty_reason: The proof classifies every compatible nonelliptic web for four explicitly defined cubic Plücker combinations, computes unique compatible edge colorings, and cancels all unwanted webs to isolate batwing, octopus, hexa-crab and tri-crab multiplicities. The full finite web enumeration, obstruction drawings and extension argument are preserved as one composite unit.
source_scope_note: The selected problem is original Theorems5.10--5.13 as one composite: the four explicitly stated cubic Pluecker differences have the exact batwing/octopus/hexa-crab/tri-crab triple-dimer twist formulas; only A/B/C have the literal stated dihedral-translate/projection extensions, while Z has only the specified Gr(3,9) statement. Complete author Sections1--5 retain face weights, twist/dimer/web conversion, every relevant finite nonelliptic-web classification and compatibility lemma, and full AppendixA1436--1541 supplies the enumerated proper-coloring/obstruction proofs. The later web-duality/tableaux and numerical computation programs are unselected. The29 exact original colored web diagrams preserve original pixels/SMasks; every caption and general mathematical proof formula remains editable native TeX. Source note: the Figure20 caption1171 names B2 web(ii) and B3 webs(iii)/(iv), while formal Lemma1176 names B2 web(iii) and B3 webs(ii)/(iv). Both literal versions, all coloring diagrams and complete Appendix proof1462--1483 remain verbatim. The selected combined main proof1203--1221 uses B1-B2-B3, and the two literal lists remove the same aggregate three webs(ii)/(iii)/(iv) with coefficient minus1; the original Appendix diagrams independently display the explicit products. Neither conflicting indexed B2/B3 subclaim is selected independently. This is the bounded root-cleared primary-unit/context disposition, not a theorem-correctness certification; no web-index, statement or proof is repaired. Approved finite typography note: exact active C18/R8/Z1 through original mathbb use only pinned installed LatinModernMath U+2102/U+211D/U+2124 as double-struck mathord; other arguments are rejected. BBOLD10 serif/stroke/width/style/placement differences are disclosed, with all27 current source/output glyph uses checked; original imports and uninvoked k/N/Q helpers remain archived/unexpanded. No bbold package is emulated or acquired; unused ytableau occurs only in omitted web-duality illustrations.
